title: Behaviour vocabulary
description: The closed vocabulary of triggers, conditions and actions a behaviour may use, now carrying the terms the stage-A extraction derived from the four reference estates. 1.0.0 states this shape and enumerates nothing, because the terms are learned from the corpus rather than known when the shape was frozen; this version closes the three derived axes and names its predecessor, which stays present and byte-identical because the arrow points backwards and no published file is ever written into. The mode and profile axes keep 1.0.0's shape: the extraction derives no mode or profile term, and enumerating a set no estate corroborates would put a fabricated vocabulary into the frozen contract.

triggers.description: Trigger block kinds the extraction observed across the four estates.

conditions.description: Condition block kinds the extraction observed across the four estates.

actions.description: Action block kinds the extraction observed across the four estates.

axes.description: The mode and profile axes a behaviour may be gated on.

terms.description: Carried from 1.0.0 unchanged for the two axes the extraction does not derive. A mode or profile term is a lower-snake-case name, and this axis gains its own enumeration, if ever, the same way the derived axes did: by a further version file and never by an edit.
